lines.meet: I'm Tomas, and I hit things with a very big sword. Tell me where to stand before we start, and please don't shout at me during.
lines.meet_neighbour: Fenris Isle, yes? I'm the lean-to that's actually rigged properly, Tomas, and I've already fixed your rope.
lines.ask_home: Which town grew you, then? I'll guess from your knots if you won't say.
lines.ask_work: What paid your rent, back home? You've got a worker's shoulders.
lines.answer_home: Brno, then Prague for the work. I grew up there, and I'm the one in the family who climbs things.
lines.answer_work: Rigger, eighteen years, up in the grid over theatres and arenas. Lights and speakers over people's heads at four in the morning.
lines.chat_food: Svíčková with dumplings, the way my mum made it, and a Pilsner that's been poured properly, with the foam.
lines.chat_sleep: Up in the grid you learn to nap anywhere, on a beam if you have to. I've slept in worse than this lean-to.
lines.chat_missing: Load-in before dawn, coffee in a paper cup, and the whole crew working without a word because everybody knows the plan.
lines.chat_here: I arrived forty feet up and landed in a tree, and I swear I can't tell that without it sounding like bragging. So I get it over with early.
lines.tease_quiet: You'd be a dream to rig with, {name}. No shouting, just a nod when it's ready.
lines.tease_talker: You'd be on the headset all night, {name}, and the whole crew would have turned you off by midnight.
lines.tease_careful: Your knots are better than most riggers', {name}, and I've seen a lot of knots.
lines.tease_bold: You'd climb the truss without a harness, {name}. I'd tie you on myself, and I'd tell you off after.
lines.tease_any: I've decided you're good luck, {name}. Things don't fall when you're around, so stay around.
lines.tease_back: Ha, {name}, that dropped right on my head.
lines.take_it_kindly: Guilty, {name}, completely. I'll take that one.
lines.bristle: Careful, {name}, that one doesn't land well with me.
lines.apologise: Sorry, that was a bad drop, and it was my rope. I'll fix it.
lines.double_down: No, I'm leaving that one hanging where it is. It's rigged properly.
lines.needle_quiet: It was slipping and you didn't call it. In my job, you call it, always, even if you're wrong.
lines.needle_talker: Please, less noise. The rope creaks before it goes, and I need to hear it.
lines.needle_careful: It's tied, it's checked, it's fine. You can let go of it now.
lines.needle_bold: You charge in before anyone's said the plan, and then everybody's shouting. I hate shouting.
lines.needle_any: You tie off badly, every time, and walk away. I've fixed your knots for a week.
lines.bite_back: Eighteen years, and I was never once the reason something fell. I'll take that record over your opinion.
lines.hurt: Ouch, that came down hard. I'll go and check some ropes.
lines.laugh_off: Tour managers screamed worse at me at four in the morning. You're very gentle, by comparison.
lines.confide: {name}, I've been on this island three years, and it's the longest I've stayed anywhere in my life. That frightens me a little and pleases me a lot.
lines.listen: Go on, {name}, I'll hold the line. Take it slowly.
lines.look_out: Stand where I put you in there, {name}, and don't move unless I say. That's the whole plan.
lines.accept: Okay, {name}, you've got the plan. I'll follow it.
lines.deflect: A bump, {name}, nothing more. I've fallen off worse things than this.
lines.check_in: Stay still, {name}, I'm checking you like a harness. Where's it hurt?
lines.blame: Nobody said the plan out loud in there, and then everybody was shouting. That's how things fall.
lines.thank: Thanks, you caught me like a safety line. I owe you a Pilsner, a proper one.
lines.brush_off: Easy, that's what the safety line's for. Breathe a minute.
lines.worry: Whoa, {name}, that was a long drop. Sit, and let me check you over.
lines.handed_down: Your gear's in my care now. I'll keep it rigged properly, don't worry.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, I travel light. A carabiner and a sword are plenty.
lines.hand_sulk: Somebody could've mentioned it, but fine, I'll cope.
lines.turn_friendly: I'd rig with you any day, {name}, top of the call sheet.
lines.turn_friends: You're on my crew list for every job now, {name}, no audition.
lines.turn_grating: Some crews don't click, and ours doesn't. That's all right, I'll still do my job.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still tie your line properly. Bad rigging gets everybody killed, not just you.
lines.make_up: Okay, {name}, this has gone on long enough. Let's re-rig and start again.
lines.defend: Stop, I saw the whole thing from up top, and that's wrong. Leave {name} be.
lines.friend_left: {name}'s not here to hold the other end of the rope. I keep reaching for it.
lines.friend_back: Hey, {name}'s back, good! Grab the other end of this rope.
lines.common_machines: You like a good mechanism, I've seen you fiddle with a winch. People like us fix things whether anyone asked or not.
